description: This file defines a Java interface 'BusinessDateMapper' using MapStruct to facilitate the mapping between 'BusinessDate' domain objects, Data Transfer Objects (DTOs), and API response/request models within the 'fineract' project. It includes methods for converting between these different representations, which helps in separating domain logic from API models and ensures clean data transformation.

classes.name: BusinessDateMapper
classes.description: A MapStruct mapper interface for converting between BusinessDate domain entities, DTOs, and API models, facilitating data transformation and decoupling between layers.

methods.name: mapEntity
methods.description: Converts a BusinessDate entity to a BusinessDateDTO, mapping the description and ignoring changes.

methods.name: mapEntity
methods.description: Converts a list of BusinessDate entities to a list of BusinessDateDTOs.

methods.name: mapUpdateRequest
methods.description: Maps a BusinessDateUpdateRequest to a BusinessDateDTO, computing description and type from the source request and converting date to LocalDate.

methods.name: mapFetchResponse
methods.description: Converts a list of BusinessDateDTOs to a list of BusinessDateResponses.

methods.name: mapFetchResponse
methods.description: Converts a single BusinessDateDTO to a BusinessDateResponse.

methods.name: mapUpdateResponse
methods.description: Converts a BusinessDateDTO to a BusinessDateUpdateResponse.
